header.running_head: Relationships between Men, Women and Children

Hadhrat Abu Tufayl (RA) relates, "I saw Rasulullaah ﷺ distributing meat in Ji'irraanah when I was a young boy who could carry only the limb of a camel. When a particular lady came to him, he spread out his shawl for her (to sit on). When I asked someone who she was, I was informed that she was the woman who suckled him as a baby." [^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Relationship with an Abyssinian Slave and With Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA)

Hadhrat Umar (RA) reports that when he once went to see Rasulullaah ﷺ, Rasulullaah ﷺ's short Abyssinian slave was busy rubbing his back. "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "Did you hurt yourself?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "The camel dropped me down last night." [^2]

Hadhrat Qaasim bin Abdur Rahmaan reports that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) used to put on Rasulullaah ﷺ's shoes for him. He would then walk ahead with Rasulullaah ﷺ's staff in his hand. When Rasulullaah ﷺ reached the gathering, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) would remove Rasulullaah ﷺ's shoes, place it under his arms and hand the staff over. As soon as Rasulullaah ﷺ decided to get up, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) would give him his shoes and again walk ahead with the staff until he entered the room before Rasulullaah ﷺ.

Another narration state that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) used to screen Rasulullaah ﷺ when he bathed, would wake him up when he slept and would walk about with him when there was no one else. [^3]
Rasulullaah ﷺ's Relationship with Hadhrat Anas (RA)

Hadhrat Anas (RA) says, "When Rasulullaah ﷺ arrived in Madinah, I was a young boy of ten and when he passed away, I was only twenty. It was my mother and aunts who encouraged me to serve Rasulullaah ﷺ." [^4]

Hadhrat Thumaamah narrates that when someone asked Hadhrat Anas (RA) whether he was present during the Battle of Badr, he replied, "Shame on you! How could I ever absent myself?" Hadhrat Muhammad bin Abdullaah Ansaari reports that Hadhrat Anas (RA) accompanied Rasulullaah ﷺ to Badr to serve him while he was still a young boy. [^5]
